title: City Sponsorship Programs for Municipalities - The Sponsorship Collective

facts.fact: The Sponsorship Collective offers a free strategy call for municipalities that want help with sponsorship programs.
The Sponsorship Collective's framework for building a sponsorship program covers audience research, valuation, prospecting, proposal creation, pitching, and fulfillment.
facts.quote: Our complete framework for building a successful sponsorship program from the ground up, covering everything from audience research to valuation

facts.fact: The Sponsorship Collective begins client engagements with an assessment to determine the client's current level of sponsorship capability.
facts.quote: we begin with an assessment to determine your current level.

facts.fact: The Sponsorship Collective states that its valuation tools help municipalities price naming rights, signage, digital placements, and other sponsorship assets.
facts.quote: With the right valuation tools, you’ll know the real worth of naming rights, signage, digital placements, and more.
